oldMapSource.title: ArXiv Data Map
oldMapSource.creator: Leland McInnes
oldMapSource.map_license: The pinned example repository declares no license. Original sources are separately attributed.

arithmetic-curves.label: Arithmetic of curves and abelian varieties

automorphic.label: Automorphic representations, trace formulae and theta lifting

complex.label: Complex analysis, Mellin transforms and poles
complex.anchorNote: The original label concerns holomorphic functions. The Lean family also includes Mellin transforms, poles and meromorphic continuations.

estimates.label: Asymptotic estimates, integration and inequalities
estimates.anchorNote: The cluster emphasizes operator and sequence estimates. Integral and asymptotic bounds elsewhere in the project share analytic methods.

etale.label: Étale cohomology, sheaves and Frobenius
etale.anchorNote: The original region combines algebraic geometry and cohomology. It accommodates étale methods at a coarser scale than the Lean topic.

finite-reps.label: Character theory and representations of groups

forms.label: Modular forms, Hecke operators and eigenforms

heights.label: Arithmetic heights, rational points and geometric estimates
heights.anchorNote: The map identifies rational-point arithmetic here. The Lean family also includes arithmetic heights and intersection estimates.

homological.label: Homological algebra and derived functors
homological.anchorNote: The original label joins homological algebra with operadic and topological structures. General exact-sequence arguments are placed in that wider region.

iwasawa.label: Iwasawa theory and cyclotomic class-group towers

langlands.label: Local Langlands parameters and smooth representations

lattices.label: Geometry of numbers and lattice volume
lattices.anchorNote: The label combines Diophantine approximation and lattice structures. Covolumes and slope inequalities occupy its geometry-of-numbers side.

lie-reps.label: Lie groups, Lie algebras and Harish-Chandra modules

linear.label: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
linear.anchorNote: The original cluster concerns matrix theory, discrepancy and designs. It supplies a reference point for a broader population of linear-algebra statements.

number-fields.label: Global fields, idèles and class groups
number-fields.anchorNote: The original label combines class groups, L-functions and exponential sums. Global field and idèle statements refer to its arithmetic neighbourhood.

padic-hodge.label: p-adic Hodge theory and crystalline periods
padic-hodge.anchorNote: The cluster emphasizes overconvergent and prismatic structures. Its relation to general p-adic Hodge theory is thematic.

polynomials.label: Polynomials, formal power series and monomials
polynomials.anchorNote: The original title names power series and monoids. The Lean family also includes multivariate polynomial rings.

prime-sums.label: Primes, weighted sums and explicit formulae

representations.label: Linear representations and invariants of groups
representations.anchorNote: The original title joins group structures and representations. More specific source cues can instead select the different anchors for Lie or p-adic representations.

rh-zeros.label: Zeros of the Riemann zeta function

topology.label: Topological spaces and continuity
topology.anchorNote: The label includes function spaces and continuous functions. The Lean topic also covers abstract topological spaces and groups.

agreement.population: All original-cluster exemplars in the archived proof-topic vocabulary, including topics with no placed Lean rows.
agreement.unit: Archived original-cluster exemplar paper, with exact June identity and unique old cluster.
agreement.scope: This measures agreement between the old exemplar clusters and June paper geography. The archived proof classifier supplies the Lean attribution evidence.

displayedAnchorAgreement.population: Only the unique June paper IDs actually used by displayed proof bundles.
displayedAnchorAgreement.unit: Archived original-cluster exemplar paper, with exact June identity and unique old cluster.
displayedAnchorAgreement.scope: This measures agreement between the old exemplar clusters and June paper geography. The archived proof classifier supplies the Lean attribution evidence.

priorDevelopmentCategoryAgreement.basis: Comparison to existing category assignments recorded independently of June in the refinement register.

method: Match previously recorded bundle arXiv IDs to a unique raw June row. Require an explicit original-cluster member. If needed, use a separately identified alternative from the same archived cluster. All geographic positions come from June paper coordinates. June topics are attributed to witness papers.
scope: A Lean source/topic assignment and a paper identity crosswalk have different evidential roles. Context-only rows use a linked theorem for navigation while their own mathematical subject remains open. Counts distinguish these rows from source-topic and vote-supported rows.
unplacedScope: Source-section-only theorem rows have no direct paper placement. Only the public manuscript-cited cohort can supply context drill-down links. Additional compiled constants are outside the written-declaration denominator.
